About Parth Packaging • Established 1995

MPCB Approved Stockist & Reconditioner of Industrial Bulk Containers & Drums

“Cleaning, repairing, reconditioning, recycling & washing of IBCs, barrels, plastic drums, fiber drums, carboys & other industrial packing materials.”

Parth Packaging is an MPCB (Maharashtra Pollution Control Board) approved Stockist and Reconditioner that started its first unit in 1995 in MIDC Tarapur, Boisar. We are engaged in buying, reconditioning, and supplying a comprehensive range of used and reconditioned Plastic Drums, Intermediate Bulk Containers (IBCs), Fiber Drums, and Carboys.

Our industrial portfolio comprises Plastic Barrels, Steel Drums, Used M.S. Barrels of every type, Used HM-HDPE Carboys (20 Ltr. to 100 Ltr.), Closed Head & Open Mouth Plastic Drums, 200 Ltr. PVC Drums, Composite Drums, and 1000 Ltr. MT Tanks—serving chemical, pharmaceutical, oil, and manufacturing plants across Boisar, Palghar, Dahanu, Vasai, Mumbai, Maharashtra, Vapi, Valsad, Gujarat, and all over India.

Quality Policy, Reconditioning Process & Warehousing

Decontamination Rigor, Closed-Loop ETP & Organized Warehousing

From chemical cleaning and 100% leak testing to segregated, pest-free warehousing in MIDC Tarapur, every stage of our operation is structured around safety, environmental compliance, and product integrity.

Multi-Stage Industrial Protocol

How We Recondition IBCs, Drums & Carboys

Zero Outside Effluent Discharge (Closed-Loop ETP)
01

Residual Removal & Decontamination

Purpose-built equipment safely extracts and treats residual contents from used IBCs, HDPE drums, M.S. barrels, and carboys in accordance with MPCB hazardous waste rules.

Inspected by Trained Workforce
02

Chemical Cleaning & Closed-Loop Washing

Containers undergo intensive chemical and high-pressure internal/external washing. All trade effluent is treated via our in-house ETP and reused for cleaning with zero outside discharge.

Inspected by Trained Workforce
03

Thermal Drying, Repair & Reconditioning

Thorough thermal drying is followed by structural reconditioning—inspecting cages, pallets, chimes, auto-sealing bungs, and two-way vented plugs.

Inspected by Trained Workforce
04

100% Leak Testing & Stage Inspection

Every reconditioned container undergoes strict pressure and leak testing with quality inspections at every stage by our trained workforce prior to segregated warehousing.

Inspected by Trained Workforce
Official Quality Policy Statement

Customer Satisfaction Through Quality & Continual Improvement

“Our aim is to satisfy our customers with quality products at affordable price, timely delivery, speedy response to their needs and expectations, continual improvement in product quality with latest technology.”

Warehousing & Safe Packaging Infrastructure

Recognizing the critical importance of contamination-free storage, our warehousing unit in MIDC Tarapur is segregated into clearly labeled sections so all reconditioned IBCs, plastic drums, fiber drums, and carboys are stocked systematically for rapid identification and dispatch.

Segregated & Labeled Sections

Organized storage zones clearly labeled by container type and specification for rapid identification and inventory accuracy.

Proper Ventilation & Dust-Free Storage

Engineered airflow systems and pest-free, dust-free warehousing preserve the internal cleanliness of decontaminated containers.

Comprehensive Fire Safety

Equipped with industrial fire safety arrangements across all storage and reconditioning bays at MIDC Tarapur.

Road & Port Connectivity

Direct logistics access to NH-48, Mumbai, Palghar, Vasai, Vapi, Valsad, and western sea ports for timely bulk dispatch.
